description: This file is a shell script designed for automating build, patching, and testing processes in a software project related to entservices and AppGateway. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring and building components with CMake, running unit tests, and generating coverage reports. It also handles plugin installation and environment setup.

methods.name: have_cmd()
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: is_root()
methods.description: Determines if the script is run as root.

methods.name: apt_can_run()
methods.description: Returns true if apt-get can be run with or without sudo.

methods.name: apt_get()
methods.description: Runs apt-get with appropriate permissions to install packages.

methods.name: run_best_effort()
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails (non-fatal).

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env()
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive Git operation.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref()
methods.description: Checks out a specific Git ref or tag in a repository.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout()
methods.description: Clones a repository and checks out a specific ref or tag.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir()
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory, idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured()
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has been configured with CMake.

methods.name: is_component_installed()
methods.description: Heuristic to check if a component is installed in the specified prefix.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install()
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component using CMake.
